'''Kyja Cho''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] and art thief during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The owner of a rare [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearl]], Cho held an auction on her [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], the ''[[Azure Sunset/Legends|Azure Sunset]]''. In attendance were several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] and aristocrats and executives from the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. One of the CSA executives was actually an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] sent secretly to the cruise on behalf of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EV" />
